                           ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the Downtown Mixed-Use District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 1-F in the area bounded by


       Beginning at a line 109.37 feet north of the intersection ofNorth
       Canal Street and North Milwaukee Avenue as measured along the
       west right-of-way line ofNorth Canal Street and perpendicular
       thereto; North Canal Street; and North Milwaukee Avenue (Tob),

to those of a DS-7 Downtown Service District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.
